scientific_integrity: All formulas are fully specified and independently reproducible with included exact symbolic calculations; no numerical enumeration is used as an infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact statement applies only to two complex Fourier zeros at 1 and 4, not approximate zeros or arbitrary sparse moment sets. Historical priority is assessed on accessible sources only; two broadly relevant older extremal-polynomial papers were not accessible in full. The universal proof is analytic and exact symbolic tests are supplementary; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sharp support-free arcs for circle measures with vanishing first and fourth Fourier moments
